name: ver02-c2-multilink-terminals
description: S6 checkpoint C2 / VER-02: terminal cleanup of the multi-link hold owner (G2: SummonGrabComponent with MaxHeldTargets > 1; the holder's multi-hold buff with SummonMultiHoldComponent, one held-state buff per target with SummonHeldComponent naming the holder, and the holder's UnitPartSummonGrappleLinks records; no native grapple parts). The product runs alone. Launch 1 loads the disposable fixture save and summons the published Giant Flytrap and Expanded Summoning horses (Large, so the published Medium-or-smaller engulf cannot promote a hold) through the product's own execution ability; each hold is made through the engine's RuleAttackWithWeapon with a distinct grab limb. Cases: one link ending by target death while its sibling stays on the same holder (with a round callback witnessed), a freed-limb regrab as the consequence check, the holder's death with the remaining links, holder death with two links plus a real move command, accelerated native summon expiry, repeated direct-release controls, an independent concurrent pair and an unrelated buff. Raw records, filtered live answers, limb occupancy, buffs and conditions are read separately before teardown. One two-link hold is left active, captured while paused and saved by the probe itself. Launch 2, a fresh process, loads that save and checks the accepted reset at load and across two rounds of game time.
